A whitespace-only subscript keeps the word separator

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>A<sub> </sub>B</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
